body:
## Summary

- Add one contextual Spatial Studio publishing wizard for saved owned Assets, procedural Effects, reusable Compositions, Scenes, and explicit immutable Environment versions.
- Publish through Harborlight's canonical license, allowlisted package, scanner, moderation, immutable release, public listing, and read-only Library installation path.
- Integrate the SC-00C paged Library candidate. Installed releases return to pinned Library inspection with a separate private working Scene; exact details retain version, license, credit, and origin beyond the first catalog page.
- Preserve validated local animation tracks through immutable release and second-Creator installation. Show resolved effects, behavior rules, and tracks in server package review.
- Check an installed Asset or Composition's exact pinned release and modification rights before adding an editable Scene copy. Retain permitted Composition lineage. Refuse self-contained Asset export of placed reusable content when its rights lineage cannot be carried.
- Accept a publishable saved Library Asset without a generated reusable marker as a credited private Scene copy after verifying its saved classification, checksum, self-contained content, and pinned Harborlight rights.
- Name reviewed saved items and required Scene Environment dependencies in Creator terms. A standalone Environment appears as the selected immutable source; technical package paths remain inspectable in the sanitized disclosure.
- Replace legacy synthetic Environment source evidence frame IDs with a generic public marker before Community package review.
- Label the selected saved source type and revision above the Content preview, including a saved Scene whose separate Community release is a Spatial asset.

## Current local integration rehearsal

The earlier R6 SC-07A product and browser-test source `7c3f76b641a1e6021bc2637c094834f099acb325` clarifies that a saved Scene without a pinned Environment publishes as a Spatial asset. The first Content step and server package review both state this before submission. An independent reviewer inspected the corrected first-step and package captures and found no remaining blocker for that focused desktop finding.

The later SC-07A product and test source `e19d7d7a89d9ea05b90836798f863161badf933b` names each saved source type and revision on the Content step. All **11/11** direct production Chromium journeys passed on that exact committed source with synthetic Creators, an isolated D: database, and capture/cleanup PASS. The [source-bound record](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/blob/9c6de12a34f7391607eb26df37752dcdc82c60ed/Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/evidence/sc-07a/20261015-source-labels/README.md) retains desktop Scene and mobile Asset captures, both run logs, and runtime/profile receipts. The first run stopped on an outdated test expectation; the corrected full run passed. Current PR documentation/evidence head is `9c6de12a34f7391607eb26df37752dcdc82c60ed`. This local proof is not a combined-source or formal Product Experience qualification.

An **unmerged local rehearsal** combines the earlier `7c3f76b641a1e6021bc2637c094834f099acb325` SC-07A product/test source with exact Crossdeck #721 (`19687c12e20ef69e6519903b14e56a145df2d7e7`) and root Parallax #722 (`325a0c5d2f37ee975d16527960048815ee8edcf9`) at `8f1e87ac25602b9bf2291e73c0174eddc11509ad`. On that exact combined source, fresh task-owned production Chromium runs passed **16/16** SC-07A and expanded Library journeys, **1/1** 2,000-Scene scale journey (10,000 indexed releases), and **4/4** compact Library and drag-placement journeys. Each browser receipt reports capture and cleanup PASS. Selected screenshots, raw receipts, hash manifests and the owner-review route are committed in the [combined R6 evidence record](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/blob/9c6de12a34f7391607eb26df37752dcdc82c60ed/Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/evidence/sc-07a/20261015-combined-r6/README.md). Full media archives remain locally under `D:\CodexTaskOutputs\sc07a-triple-browser-20261015-r6`, `D:\CodexTaskOutputs\sc07a-triple-scale-20261015-r6`, and `D:\CodexTaskOutputs\sc07a-triple-compact-20261015-r6`. This does not qualify the separate PR head or replace protected Product Experience capture, physical validation, or owner acceptance.

## Local evidence

- The [SC-07A combined adaptation, twelve-journey coverage audit and owner-review route](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/blob/9c6de12a34f7391607eb26df37752dcdc82c60ed/Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/SC_07A_Combined_Adaptation_20261015.md) maps private save, package review, publication, approval, listing, installation, credited reuse, immutable update, rights refusal, privacy and accessibility to exact local evidence and open protected gates. It is a walkthrough for owner inspection, not a claim of owner acceptance.
- All 11 SC-07A production Chromium cases passed on exact product and browser-test source `6d0ea2b8896915c2ea7c94ef58a93e1f80e65ee1`, with a fresh isolated SQLite database, synthetic identities, production build, and owned cleanup PASS. A focused Scene and standalone Environment review run passed 2/2 on that source. Inspected captures show the Creator-facing labels and privacy warnings; assertions confirm that technical paths remain inspectable in sanitized JSON and private photo filenames are absent. The preceding saved-Asset correction also passed a focused installed-reuse journey 1/1 and a complete 11/11 run on `058b901a60e93c720b1b07c65c532e06cbcb46b5`; its two failed attempts remain retained.
- Test-only source `05356c5f7788f65bb89aced9522d40f3f674b734` adds a 390 px final Environment review capture and assertions for dialog bounds, visible submit action, and no serious or critical axe findings. Its focused 1/1 and complete 11/11 production Chromium reruns passed with fresh isolated data and owned cleanup. The product source was unchanged.
- Test-only source `4fd031c23faf6553c2430649dbf56648f6acf7db` checks a reviewed Scene after its pinned Environment changes ownership. Fresh review and submission with the earlier digest both refuse the dependency, create no listing, and leave the private Scene saved. All 6/6 isolated SC-07A integration cases passed on that committed source. [Source-bound receipt](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/blob/df5b7fcb8e8c8ea13fc569fa5a95d609fbeeacb0/Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/evidence/sc-07a/20261015-dependency-revocation/README.md).
- Current privacy correction `5b0f6b3a05d4110462b90f984bc0f20be6fd18e6` replaces the SC-01 synthetic Environment's source `evidence.frameId` with `community-simulated` in public package bytes. A focused assertion confirms a source named `private-room-photo.jpg` is absent from the reviewed package. Package tests passed 13/13, fresh isolated Harborlight integration passed 6/6, TypeScript, targeted lint and documentation validation passed. A task-owned production Chromium run passed **11/11** on that exact product and test source. Test-only continuation `1e3c8f1620b3b36fa4d2b4726c054659ce68ad48` explicitly selects a Harborlight license, enters tags and an extra credit, and verifies their persisted release values; its fresh production Chromium rerun passed **11/11**, with capture and owned cleanup PASS and released ports. A further isolated SC-01 compatibility case at `2695024debb096b63931c5b92969082f14e7360a` proves canonical review, publication and second-Creator read-only installation keep the public frame generic while the original source remains unchanged; all **7/7** integration cases passed. The [source-bound logs and receipts](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/blob/a22e265f78a06b195838a59f98c5c4add67d94a6/Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/evidence/sc-07a/20261015-frame-sanitize/README.md) are committed at documentation head `a22e265f78a06b195838a59f98c5c4add67d94a6`, which does not change product source.
- The focused reusable-asset unit suite passed 12/12 on the correction. Earlier authoring/package suites passed 144/144; Library/license suites passed 41/41; fresh isolated Harborlight integration passed 5/5, including allowed Composition reuse and license-restricted Composition and Asset refusals. TypeScript, targeted lint, documentation validation, 50 Product Experience contract tests, and Feature Catalog sync/validation passed.
- The branch merged current protected main `aaef39a57d2c89ca57136dce327d337c5cb0ef7f` at `da7d195828fa2ab43bcd049daa7661f57c35a4bf`. TypeScript, documentation validation, Feature Catalog validation, and the 50 Product Experience contract tests passed on the merged tree. The merge did not change SC-07A product code.
- Protected R4 infrastructure main `a2495fd14efd5ade67832e18fd260f32da98b3b2` merged at `bbaf7f13646ff25bb7c11e12ba14617764cdcc54`. TypeScript, documentation validation and **51/51** focused Product Experience authority tests passed. The broader Sounding Line suite passed **190/192**; its R3/R4 Git-admission fixtures reject the SC-07A branch's additional source tree with `PRODUCT_EXPERIENCE_EXCEPTION_FROZEN_PRODUCT_CHANGED`. The frozen-product guard was neither changed nor waived. The exact branch-local limitation is recorded in the owner-review document.
- Earlier exact-product-source browser logs, receipts and gate results are in `Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/evidence/sc-07a/20261015-frame-sanitize/README.md`. The earlier Scene and Environment captures are in `Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/evidence/sc-07a/20261015-review-labels/README.md`; saved-Asset reuse and its retained failed attempts are in `Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/evidence/sc-07a/20261015-asset-reuse/README.md`. Earlier installed-rights, animation, package-review, and recovery evidence remains linked from the Parallax project index.
- Coordinated [SC-00C expanded Library PR #739](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/pull/739) is a separate draft. Its pushed handoff `e4b953b8775fbb672d320af1fdb1dbccd4a418c7` contains this SC-07A documentation head `90ce26e92df8d0d01d3164f8f617352e6cfbb7fd`. Bounded independent source rereview resolved the reported saved physical scale, root-animation and keyboard presearch findings on repair source `c5b977c81f757355783f0f32100d32333f380905` plus `9491faf6a6183fc27c79d6aeb98a844d3256e503`. Final test source `7ac7594e665ef1a3d2c5e2c4bf33c0133139ce65` passed **3/3** isolated production Chromium journeys: delayed Cancel and private placement, installed Harborlight Asset return, and scaled keyboard/pointer placement with rendered root movement; capture and cleanup report PASS. The installer-context video is now retained under its own name beside the unchanged publisher recording. [Source-bound receipts and retained fixture failure](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/blob/e4b953b8775fbb672d320af1fdb1dbccd4a418c7/Development_Docs/Projects/Project_Parallax/evidence/sc-00c/20261015-expanded-library/README.md) belong to #739. The earlier **26/26** Library and Community pass plus 2,000-Scene case remain bound to their previous source. This SC-07A draft has not adopted SC-00C's downstream placement changes; protected qualification remains open.

## Remaining gates and limits

- The formal Product Experience planner on current PR head `9c6de12a34f7391607eb26df37752dcdc82c60ed` against protected main `a2495fd14efd5ade67832e18fd260f32da98b3b2` still exits `PRODUCT_EXPERIENCE_EXPERIENCE_DESIGN_REQUIRED:crossdeck.phase2.continuity:Crossdeck and Parallax experience integration`. The separately owned [Crossdeck product PR #721](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/pull/721) remained draft after its [final R4 qualification attempt](https://github.com/Kgray44/treasurehuntSoT/actions/runs/38822426167) failed in custody reservation during a network fetch, before product verification. Protected main did not change, and the Crossdeck owner is preserving that terminal result under its R4 no-retry rule. Root Parallax PR #722 is also draft and currently conflicting. A read-only two-way preflight with Crossdeck at local commit `ce1034ffedd9e9fdd90115f1ffbc59a9672969cd` still reports `PRODUCT_EXPERIENCE_UNREGISTERED_SURFACE`; 316 of its 348 changed `src`/`public` paths are byte-identical to #722. Crossdeck landing alone does not qualify SC-07A. Replan against the actual protected tree after the dependencies land. The local three-way rehearsal is supporting evidence only.
- Formal Product Experience capture and independent review, protected Sounding Line qualification, landed smoke, real-device presentation, and owner acceptance remain open. Local synthetic browser proof does not establish room safety or scanner-provider behavior.
- Spatial collection publication remains unavailable because the current free-text organizer is not an immutable dependency-closed source. Photo-derived rooms and observed or media-linked room features are refused; the current package contract cannot establish that their layout is safe to distribute. A Creator may publish an independently authored synthetic Environment after reviewing its geometry and acknowledging the residual privacy risk. Placed reusable assets without verified source licenses and pinned package dependencies, and physical models or media without resolved rights and scanner inputs, are visibly refused.
